dse_runs.notes: Spec is named infeasible: needs >=400 MSPS single-lane with max_abs_err <= 2^-12. If the front shows no feasible points, map the best near-feasible tradeoff (min LUTs vs accuracy) anyway; pipelined families are the only route to high throughput.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **infeasible_dds_400msps** was taken down the ladder and finalized as infeasible: the structured DSE graph (100 evals) had the inner architect declare the spec infeasible, and I confirmed this by spending the remaining 300 evals on targeted NSGA-II studies of the high-throughput families — pipelined (100), pipelined_m with m=2..8 (100), and unrolled_k with k=2..8 (100) — all yielding 0 feasible designs meeting throughput ≥ 400 MSPS with max_abs_err ≤ 2⁻¹². L2 had nothing feasible to simulate, so L3–L5 were not applicable, and the spec was finalized with no design selected after all 400 L1 evaluations were spent.
